description.narrative: Det liberianska inrikesministeriet har ansökt om bidrag till finansiering av Liberia Decentralization Support Program (LDSP), under 2016-2017. Programmet har följande förväntade (outcome) resultat: Den statliga administrationen på lokal nivå lokal förvaltar de delegerade resurserna och levererar offentliga tjänster; den lokala förvaltningens leverans av tjänster och ansvarstagande har förbättrats; det legala ramverket för decentraliserad stryre är färdig; det liberianska inrikesministeriet och Governance Commission har ökad kapacitet att leda och genomföra decentraliseringsreformer. Insatsens totala budget är upskattad till USD 19.9 miljoner, och budgeten för 2016-2017 är USD 12.7 miljoner. Sverige planerar att bidra med SEK 45 miljoner. Övriga finansiärer är den liberianska staten och utvecklingspartners EU, UNDP, UNMIL och USAID.

The Liberian Ministry of Internal Affairs has requested Embassy of Sweden support for funding Liberia Decentralization Support Program during 2015-2017. The expected outcomes are: "Deconcentrated services and corresponding resources management at the assigned level of government; improved service delivery and accountability of local governments; necessary legal and regulatory framework for decentralization is in place; and capacity-building of the responsible institutions. The intervention's total budget is USD 19.9 million. The other development partners contributing with funding EU USD 5.5 million, UNDP USD 2.5 million, USAID USD 1.0 million and UNMIL USD 0.5 million. The Liberian government has allocated in the current annual budget USD 0.5 million. Sweden will contribute USD 5.2 million.

sector.narrative: Decentralisation and support to subnational government

description.narrative: A key milestone achievement under the LDSP was the establishment of fifteen County Service Centers (CSC's), one CSC in each ounty throughout Liberia. The CSC's have established SOP's and are providing various services including driving licenses, marriage certificates and other important documents, which otherwise have to be received from Monrovia. A main achievement of the LDSP was the advocacy effort during a four year period which resulted in the enactment of the Local Government Act (LGA) and subsequently signed into law. It provides an enabling legal environment for effective and efficient implementation of decentralization and the devolution of certain political, administrative and fiscal powers and institutions from the central government to local governments. Another milestone achievement with support of the LDSP was the development of the ten year Strategic Plan to operationalize the LGA. The Embassy of Sweden has been engaged in the consultations on this activity, in close cooperation with USAID, EU and other partners and the host government/MIA in particular. This was critical, as any future action and programme support to Decentralization reform in Liberia will be based on this Strategic Plan. A fourth milestone achievement was that which resulted from the overall emphasis of LDSP on human capacity building of key stakeholders linked to the reform efforts, including staff at the Ministry of Internal Affairs and the LDSP Implementation Secretariat and the Governance Commission, with a view to be in position to guide and managage the decentralization reform efforts in the future.
